rules.guidance: Avoid `any` — it disables type-checking. Prefer a precise type, `unknown` + narrowing, or a generic.
`useEffect`/`useCallback`/`useMemo` dependency arrays must list every referenced value, or you get stale closures.
List items rendered with `.map` need a stable, unique `key`; a missing key causes incorrect reconciliation.
Don't use the array index as a React `key` when the list can reorder/insert — it breaks state association.
Never call a state setter during render — it loops/crashes. Do it in an effect or an event handler.
Don't make the `useEffect` callback itself `async` (it returns a Promise, not a cleanup); define an inner async fn and call it.
`dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with non-sanitized content is an XSS sink; sanitize or avoid.
